programs.title: Parwana
programs.desc: Parwana, a thief, steals a bag containing explosives, which belongs to a dangerous man. The police then set out to hunt him as he is now labelled a terrorist.

programs.title: Mangal Pandey: The Rising
programs.desc: Mangal Pandey and William Gordon become friends during a war in Afghanistan. But when the East India Company introduces a rifle that uses objectionable cartridges, Mangal Pandey rises in revolt.

programs.title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
programs.desc: A waiter, is in love with the famous TV reporter Greeta Kapoor. After a man is murdered, Kapoor shows up at Raju's door to ask him some questions - it turns out that Raju served the dead man his last supper.

programs.title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
programs.desc: Raj and Priya, a married couple, hire Madhubala, a prostitute, as the surrogate mother of their child. Trouble brews when Madhubala falls in love with Raj and insists on keeping the child.

programs.title: Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta
programs.desc: Raj is a lawyer who finds great success through his habit of lying. However, when his son wishes for his father to stop lying, Raj is magically forced to speak the truth and gets into trouble.

programs.title: Karobaar: The Business of Love
programs.desc: Friends Rajiv and Amar go their separate ways after Seema decides to be with Amar rather than Rajiv. Years later, prosecution lawyer Amar is delighted to see Rajiv in court and accused of murder.
